question:
Select the appropriate synonym of the given word.

Candid
solution:
The correct answer is: **Honest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Candid"** means being truthful, straightforward, and honest in speech or behaviour. (स्पष्ट, निष्कपट)

 
 
• **Example:** She gave a candid assessment of the challenges the team is facing.
 
 
 
• **"Honest"** refers to someone or something that is truthful, sincere, and free from deceit. (ईमानदार)
 
 
• **Example:** The honest man always speaks the truth, no matter the consequences.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Candid'** is **'Honest'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Honest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deceptive** (छलपूर्ण): Misleading or giving a false impression.

 
 
• **Example:** His deceptive behavior made it hard to trust him.
 
 
 
• **Reserved** (संकोची): Someone who is shy or reluctant to share their thoughts and feelings.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite being reserved, she managed to express her ideas effectively.
 
 
 
• **Hesitant** (हिचकिचाहट): Unsure or slow to act due to uncertainty or fear.
 
 
• **Example:** He was hesitant to speak up in the meeting.
